title: Team AI Governance Without Bureaucracy
description: Create practical team rules for AI usage: what is allowed, what requires approval, and how to protect data while still moving fast.

data.text: Most organizations need AI guardrails, but heavy policy documents fail in practice. Effective governance is short, clear, and directly tied to daily decisions: what data can be pasted, which tools are approved, and when human sign-off is mandatory.

items.text: Approved tools list (and tools explicitly not approved)
Data classification rules (public / internal / sensitive / restricted)
Allowed and disallowed AI use cases by risk level
Human review requirements for high-impact outputs
Incident reporting path for AI mistakes or leaks

rows: Low risk; human editor still reviews
Uploading customer PII to free chatbot

data.title: Governance that works
points: Keep policy short and operational (1-2 pages)
Focus on decisions people make daily
Classify data first, then decide tool usage
Add mandatory review for high-impact outputs
Revisit policy monthly as tools and risks evolve
